Exceptional Veterinary Care - Experience the difference at Union Lake Veterinary Hospital. Our YouTube channel educates you about the care of your fur family and introduces you to our services and our staff. If you have a suggestion for a video topic, let us know. 

Union Lake Veterinary Hospital provides the Waterford, West Bloomfield and surrounding areas with loving, high-quality veterinary medical care. We're open 7 days a week for your convenience, offering the best traditional veterinary medicine as well as alternative therapies like chiropractic, acupuncture and herbal therapies. 

Union Lake Pet Services next door offers pet grooming, pet boarding, doggy daycare, dog training, and our Animal Rehabilitation Center offers canine physical therapy. We're Michigan's most complete pet care complex.
